description: This Java source file defines the `FtpServices` class, which provides FTP transfer services for content within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating FTP clients, handling FTP connections, and transferring content resources to various types of FTP servers, with support for redirection and verification.

classes.name: FtpServices
classes.description: Provides static methods to facilitate FTP-based transfer of content resources, including connection management and file transfer procedures, tailored for the Apache OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createFtpClient
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an FTP client implementation based on the server type (ftp, ftps, sftp). Throws GeneralException if a secure FTP is not yet implemented.

methods.name: sendContentToFtp
methods.description: Main service method to send content to an FTP server, handling connection setup, file upload, optional zipping, and verification. Uses determinant properties and entity queries to locate and verify resources.

parameters.name: dctx
parameters.description: The dispatch context provided by OFBiz for service invocation.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Input parameters including content and contact details.
